generalSituation: The northeast monsoon will affect southern China today and tomorrow, and the upper-air disturbances will also bring showers and thunderstorms to the region. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong tomorrow night. It will be windier and showers will ease off over the region early next week. Under the persistent influence of the dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. It will be slightly cooler in the morning. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas.
